question: Pulmonary hypertension occurs as a consequence of:

options.opa: Bronchoconstriction and inflammation of the upper respiratory tract.
options.opb: Bronchoconstriction and inflammation of the lower respiratory tract.
options.opd: Vasoconstriction of the arterioles of the systemic circulation.
options.ope: Vasoconstriction of the arterioles of the pulmonary circulation.
